name: Downhole gas and water separation
principle: Gravity or hydrocyclone separators split produced fluid downhole so the oil-rich stream is lifted and the water-rich stream is reinjected into another zone. Trials show properly operating systems may cut water brought to surface by about 75%.

process_steps.name: Packers isolate the zone and feed the intake

performance.basis: majority of properly operating DOWS in trials

source.note: Wikipedia, Downhole oil-water separation technology, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

limitations: Downhole gas separation is not covered by the source read
